title: The Fairmount Tool Library
prompt: A one-pager for a neighborhood tool library we want to start, to hand to the community center board.
note: Community register: a serif headline and subhead, a narrow measure, and warm spacing, because a board of volunteers reads this on paper and a dense grid would feel like a vendor pitch. The problem and the proposal are two paragraphs with a small inline SVG landmark each rather than a band, the ask is one bordered card listing the three things the board can literally vote yes to, and the risks are a ruled list that says plainly what happens if nobody comes.
